QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] Something Shocking
QuestInfo.0: You must stop whatever evil is afoot on the White Heaven. Be sure to check each room.
QuestInfo.1: Stop the Pixies and the Lightning monsters from doing... whatever they're doing. And take away their Thunder Sparks!

item.0: I mean, I'm STILL tingling from that shock. That can't be good for anyone!
